author: TNN
description: Abarna, a 17-year-old girl from Solaipudur, was murdered by Muthuraj after rejecting his demands. The incident occurred at her home in Sawyerpuram, involving a fatal stabbing and strangulation. Muthuraj, who had known Abarna for two years, also attempted suicide after the attack. Police arrived promptly and took Muthuraj to the hospital for treatment. Investigations are ongoing as authorities handle the case.

description: A remarkable discovery at Lötschen Pass has unearthed a 4,000-year-old bronze neck ring, making it the first metal artifact found at this significant historical site. While previous discoveries were primarily organic materials preserved in ice, this find suggests that ancient peoples may have practiced mobility through Alpine passes, connecting various regions. Experts speculate that the ring could have served as a ritual offering or token of gratitude.
title: Swiss Alps ice retreat reveals 4,000-year-old bronze neck ring on mountain pass

description: A military operation in Guasave led to the arrest of cartel leader Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro. Cartel operatives retaliated by setting up roadblocks and burning vehicles across the city. Local businesses suffered damage, and residents sought shelter amid gunfire and military intervention.

description: In a strategic move, Gadi Eisenkot has called upon members of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party to engage in coalition negotiations. The objective is to create a national unity government that reflects the fractured state of the current parliament. Eisenkot's party, Yashar, sees this invitation as a demonstration of their dedication to establishing a wide-ranging government.

description: On Friday, a 580-kg marlin fish became an attraction at Koti Chennaya Fish Centre in Ujire. The fish drew hundreds of people, including schoolchildren and bus passengers, who came to see it. Proprietor Nagesh highlighted that this fish was the largest of its kind he has brought to the shop. He noted that such large fish are considered a delicacy due to their minimal bones and excellent taste.
title: 580kg giant marlin draws hundreds to Koti Chennaya Fish Centre in Mangaluru's Ujire

author: PINTO DEEPAK
description: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant addressed the need for a balanced approach to AI in legal education. He emphasized the importance of independent reasoning and academic integrity for future lawyers. Kant also proposed mandatory legal aid work for law students to enhance practical learning. The conference highlighted legal education's evolution, incorporating new subjects like cyber laws into the curriculum.

description: Researchers at the University of St Andrews have pioneered a groundbreaking technique to harness whale DNA through the use of drones. This method captures genetic material from the whales' breath, often referred to as whale snot. Their findings successfully sequenced complete genomes from specimens gathered off the coast of British Columbia.
title: Scientists sample humpback whale breath by drone, find 3 new genetic variants

description: Dua Lipa is making waves with the transformation of her Victorian home in Hampstead, which includes an ambitious plan for a luxurious basement pool. After encountering numerous setbacks, the project received the green light to commence construction in 2024. Local environmental concerns have prompted strict adherence to regulations, pushing the anticipated completion to 2027. With an investment estimated at around £3 million, this renovation underscores its intricate and grand vision.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Onnie James Florence Jr. encountered significant legal troubles stemming from his failure to pay homeowners' association fees for his condominium in Indiana. After acquiring the unit, he neglected to keep up with payments while residing in Illinois. The Meridian Arch Owners Association successfully secured a default judgment against him for the overdue fees. Despite making a partial payment later, additional fees remained unpaid, prompting ongoing legal action.

description: In a stunning real estate move, a penthouse in Beverly Hills has shattered local records by selling for $21 million within just 10 days of listing. Initially priced at $27.5 million, the luxe property ultimately changed hands for 24% less, showcasing its many high-end amenities and hotel-style services for residents. The fortunate buyer also saved over $1 million in transfer taxes by opting for Beverly Hills over Los Angeles.

description: A cargo vessel named Sparta II was struck by drones while in international waters on Saturday. The attack caused the vessel to catch fire and drift into Finnish territorial waters. Finnish authorities are monitoring the situation and preparing for potential rescue operations. The attack is significant due to the vessel's military logistics links and ongoing tensions in the region.
title: Russian cargo vessel linked to defence ministry comes under drone attack near Finland

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Myanmar has rejected the International Court of Justice ruling regarding genocide against the Rohingya in 2017. France's foreign ministry plans to seek a UN Security Council meeting in response to Myanmar's refusal. Additionally, Article 94 of the UN charter obligates all member states to comply with ICJ decisions. The Gambia can also approach the Security Council regarding Myanmar's non-compliance with the ruling.
title: France to take Rohingya genocide row to UN after Myanmar rejects ICJ verdict

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Marcelo Fascino, a 24-year-old from San Antonio, Texas, stands accused of securing more than $1.6 million in federal contracts by deceitfully claiming his business was owned by veterans. He allegedly misrepresented his military background, impersonated government officials, and manipulated suppliers to stifle competition. Furthermore, investigators found he sold counterfeit military gear, mislabeling it as American-made but failing to meet specifications. He faces several charges as the investigation proceeds.
title: Texas man accused of posing as veteran to win $1.6m contracts, supply fake gear

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: At the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum, hosted at Delhi's Purana Quila, Pakistan's minister Musadik Malik elaborated on the site's historical relevance, paying tribute to Mughal emperor Humayun and Afghan ruler Sher Shah Suri. He emphasized the necessity of dialogue among various cultures. The forum, which was kicked off by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, seeks to illuminate India's diverse civilizational heritage via displays and archaeological findings.
title: Humayun, Sher Shah, one fort: Pak min highlights Purana Quila’s history at SCO forum

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Marcellus Young Casario, an 18-year-old football player, died unexpectedly on November 13 due to a sudden medical incident. His family reported that he had felt unwell before going to sleep after getting water. An autopsy has been completed, but the family awaits toxicology results to understand the cause. His school, Rabun Gap-Nacoochee, and teammates mourn his loss while commemorating his contributions.

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: US Representative Jim Himes has warned SpaceX about potential funding cuts if it does not clarify its actions regarding Ukraine. The company faced scrutiny over its restrictions on satellite communications that impacted Ukraine's military operations. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported systematic disruptions affecting military technology amid ongoing conflict. Disagreements over who controls the Starshield system have arisen among government officials and SpaceX.
title: US lawmaker turns up heat on Musk over Ukraine Starshield disruptions

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A rare painting by Hilma af Klint just sold for a jaw-dropping 128.9 million Swedish kronor at auction! It blew past its original estimate of 6 to 8 million kronor. Painted in 1920 and titled Ser III No. 5, this piece had been with a family for over 30 years and shows off af Klint's unique style and spirituality.
title: Hilma af Klint painting expected to fetch SEK 8m sells for record SEK 128.9m

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In Gloucester, Massachusetts, a 26-home housing initiative is meeting resistance from environmental groups. The Essex County Greenbelt intends to purchase the 94-acre woodland to preserve the area's natural environment. Future objectives include establishing walking trails to connect this space with adjacent conservation properties. Though most funding is secured, necessary approvals from the local council are still pending, alongside the open wetlands application by the Conservation Commission.

description: In a significant ruling, a federal judge has barred the construction of a controversial monument near Arlington National Cemetery. The Trump administration aims to appeal this ruling, defending their vision for the monument amidst ongoing debates over presidential authority regarding national landmarks.

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: Shehzad Poonawalla clarified that his exit from active politics is not due to dislike for the BJP. He expressed his ongoing support for Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other BJP leaders. Differences with his brother Tehseen Poonawalla were framed as a clash of principles rather than personal issues. Shehzad emphasized that every person in India should identify as Hindu.

He recognizes the challenges presented by Iran's current regime yet believes there might be potential for more reasonable negotiations. His goal is to secure a lasting pact that prevents Iran from developing nuclear capabilities.

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Geoffrey Boycott has sharply criticized Steven Smith for his inaction during the infamous 2018 ball-tampering scandal. He believes that Smith's choice to disengage from the team’s scheme is simply unacceptable. Boycott insists that the gravity of this scandal eclipses Hansie Cronje's match-fixing in 2000, especially considering the entire Australian team was reportedly implicated. In light of the controversy, Smith took accountability and received a one-year suspension from Cricket Australia.

Unfortunately, veteran batter Mushfiqur Rahim will miss the game due to a groin injury incurred in the first Test, confirmed by an MRI showing pelvic inflammation. In a surprising turn, South Africa's captain Temba Bavuma will also be sidelined with a calf strain, leading Aiden Markram to step in as captain.

description: Vishva Hindu Parishad has raised objections against the film 'Ramayana', claiming it distorts elements of the epic. The organization accuses the film's makers of fabricating incidents and omitting key characters. Allegations include the film's portrayal of Ravana as a liberator of certain communities, which they find problematic. Critics argue that essential messages of the Ramayana are not depicted in the film's narrative.

description: Manchester City’s 14-year dominance over Fulham ended with a 1-1 draw at the Etihad, snapping the visitors’ 20-match losing streak against them. Rodrigo Muniz gave Fulham an early lead before Elliott Anderson rescued a point for City. The result extended City’s winless Premier League run to four matches, leaving them third, five points behind leaders Arsenal.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Sir Cameron Mackintosh's generous donation of £2 million to Denville Hall marks a significant step in supporting assisted living facilities dedicated to the performing arts, particularly with the new center being named in honor of Richard and Sheila Attenborough. Denville Hall, known for its commitment to care, has initiated a £26 million Centenary Appeal to further improve its offerings, backed by the support of many celebrated entertainment industry figures.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a significant ruling, an Arizona couple, Kevin and Jennifer LoPresto, sought to replace their single gate with a wider double gate to accommodate their disabled son's golf cart. The Wigwam Creek South Community Association rejected their request and pushed for arbitration. However, an appeals court sided with the LoPrestos, allowing their lawsuit against the HOA to continue and awarding them reasonable legal fees for the appeals process.

This initiative aims to boost the fleet from 286 to 398 vessels by 2056, but has sparked concern over funding viability. Additionally, prolonged ship deployments are exerting pressure on operational capabilities and personnel, complicating the Navy's goal of sustaining a global presence amid rising financial and logistical hurdles.

This vandalism was denounced by leaders from both the BJP and BRS, who claimed it jeopardized the city's business-friendly image. N Ramchander Rao, president of Telangana BJP, criticized Congress for promoting such destructive behavior. Meanwhile, K T Rama Rao of BRS articulated that such incidents erode trust in companies like Meta.

HUD Secretary Scott Turner expressed dissatisfaction with the decision, citing potential disruptions to funding processes.

The officer has been admitted to the hospital and is said to be in stable condition. Investigations are underway to uncover the motive for the shooting, with no prior offenses linked to Negi being reported.

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA

They assured that all American aircraft in the Middle East are secure and accounted for, highlighting rising tensions between the US and Iran during this period.

author: AASTHA JHA
description: In May 2025, China's military support for Pakistan intensified India's security dilemmas. This report reveals Beijing's ongoing strategies aimed at stifling India's strategic advancements through both military and economic tactics. The evolving military alliance between China and Pakistan poses greater risks for India moving forward, showcasing a troubling shift in regional security dynamics.

Trump avoided directly answering which of them he preferred as his successor when questioned.

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Russia has shown a potential openness to explore security guarantees for Ukraine, inspired by NATO's framework. This could enable Ukraine to gain necessary protections while allowing Moscow to maintain its control over specific occupied lands. A ceasefire along existing front lines is essential to pave the way for a lasting peace agreement.

description: In a recent release, the Pentagon unveiled a treasure trove of documents on UFO investigations dating as far back as the 1950s. description: Darren Lehmann firmly states he was unaware of the ball-tampering scheme that emerged during the contentious 2018 tour in South Africa. He reflects on the heavy personal consequences of the scandal while accepting his role as coach. With Usman Khawaja's recent remarks reigniting discussions, Lehmann reiterates his stance, highlighting the emotional ramifications of the incident and expressing sympathy for those involved.

author: TNN
description: In a troubling incident at the district hospital, a woman attendant was allegedly harassed by an intruder early in the morning while she was tending to a patient and resting nearby. The man managed to enter the ward unnoticed, raising serious security alarms, especially after reports of over ten mobile phones and cash being stolen from attendants recently.

description: Akhilesh Yadav and Rahul Gandhi are negotiating a seat-sharing arrangement for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. The roots of the dispute go back to a 1949 property deal and a 1964 access document that lacked precision.

The appeals court sent the case back for further hearings regarding property rights and road usage.

description: Sonam Wangchuk accused the Ladakh administration of effectively placing him under house arrest since November 11. He appealed to President Droupadi Murmu and Prime Minister Narendra Modi to uphold constitutional values. Wangchuk expressed concerns about government misuse of police for actions that compromise their duties. He opposed the timing of Hill Council elections, arguing that many residents would be unable to participate.

description: In a disappointing turn at the Hong Kong Open Super 500, India's Lakshya Sen and the men's doubles team were knocked out in the semifinals. Lakshya lost decisively to Anders Antonsen from Denmark, with the match concluding at 21-13, 21-13. Meanwhile, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty fought valiantly but were edged out by the Malaysian team. Despite promising performances in previous tournaments, this time India couldn't secure a spot in the finals.

description: In Tuticorin, a 17-year-old girl named Abarna was killed by her boyfriend Muthuraj during an argument. The altercation arose when he insisted she stop talking to other boys. Investigations into the incident are currently ongoing to gather more information.

description: A Pakistani delegation, led by Musadik Masood Malik, is in India for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum. This visit marks the first by a Pakistani minister to India in three years. The programme emphasizes shared civilizational heritage and cross-cultural engagement among SCO member countries.

author: JAIDEEP DEOGHARIA
description: A truck owner from Rampur district saw his vehicle repossessed by IndusInd Bank over a minor default in payments. However, the tide turned when the National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission ruled in his favor, ordering the bank to pay Rs 7.7 lakh in compensation plus interest. This decision emphasizes the importance of consumer rights in the context of vehicle repossession and auction practices.

description: In an intense showdown, Cristiano Ronaldo initially gave Al-Nassr the advantage with his opening goal, but a missed penalty haunted the team. Al-Ahli responded with Galeno's goal and Ivan Toney's successful penalty kick, flipping the game in their favor. Roger Ibanez subsequently scored from a corner, securing a 3-1 victory for Al-Ahli and propelling them up the league table, while Al-Nassr faced a frustrating defeat despite Ronaldo's contributions.

description: With her groundbreaking technology, Vidhya Parshuramkar has revolutionized the shelf life of pearl millet flour, stretching it from a few days to several months. Her initiative, Nutri Dabba, not only provides nutritious snacks to over 400,000 schoolchildren in rural India but also actively combats iron deficiency and nurtures healthier eating practices. Furthermore, Vidhya champions rural women and collaborates with local farmers to bolster food security.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: MacKenzie Scott's philanthropic initiative in 2024 selected 361 nonprofit organizations to receive $640 million. Through an open application process, more than 6,000 groups submitted requests for funding. The selected organizations focused on issues related to economic disparities, education, healthcare, and discrimination. Scott's approach shifted from private research to an open call, increasing both funding and recipients. This effort follows her significant charitable donations made after her divorce from Jeff Bezos.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In a groundbreaking study, scientists have discovered 99 bat species in Bolivia's Madidi National Park, marking the first sightings of seven species in the nation. Employing diverse methods for capturing and monitoring these fascinating creatures across various altitudes, the research highlights the park's critical role in preserving bat habitats and its exceptional biodiversity, underscoring the urgent need to protect this vital ecosystem for the health of these species.

Bhagwat conveyed his belief in the persistent significance of Sanatan Dharma in today's world, celebrating both the foundation of Akhand Deep and the birth centenary of Mata Bhagwati Devi Sharma.

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Tanks have long served an essential role in modern warfare, providing mobile firepower and protection to troops. Recent conflicts, including the war in Ukraine, have highlighted their vulnerabilities against advanced weaponry. To address these challenges, the Indian Army is enhancing its existing T-72 and T-90 tanks through innovative technologies. These improvements include integrating drones, artificial intelligence, and advanced ammunition systems for better battlefield effectiveness.
title: The tank was once king of the battlefield, drones have changed the rules, and India is adapting

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: India A are set to compete against Pakistan A in the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026. The match will be crucial as both teams look to maintain their winning streaks. India A had a dominant victory over Nepal by a massive margin in their previous match. Pakistan A, defending their title, also secured a comfortable win against the United Arab Emirates.
title: India A vs Pakistan A Asia Cup Rising Stars: Date, time, live streaming and squads

author: KARAN MANRAL
title: Italy's ex-police chief dies amid probe into mafia case cover-up; suicide suspected

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: The Indian Navy's Fleet Air Arm has historically supported land operations through naval aviation. Its contribution dates back to the 1965 war, where reconnaissance aircraft identified enemy radar installations. The Boeing 737-based P-8I enhanced these capabilities and was deployed during confrontations with China in recent years. Live feeds from these aircraft aid the Army in monitoring troop movements and strengthening joint operations.
title: Navy's Fleet Air Arm: From tracking enemy radars in 1965 to monitoring China along LAC

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Europe is considering a tax targeting major digital corporations as a means to fund its upcoming budget from 2028 to 2034. European Council President Antonio Costa has introduced a revised plan which significantly reduces the EU budget proposed by the European Commission. This initiative reflects the differing financial priorities of EU member states and may intensify trade tensions between Brussels and Washington if approved.
title: 'Make Big Tech pay': EU eyes digital tax to fund €2 trillion budget

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: KL Rahul's tour of New Zealand was backed by months of homework, hours in the nets and a clear game plan. From studying videos of Joe Root and Harry Brook to adapting to the conditions at the Basin Reserve, Rahul left little to chance. The result was a memorable century and another milestone in his remarkable overseas Test career.
title: Lot of videos, hours in nets and solid game plan: How KL Rahul cracked the NZ code

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Shubman Gill and Rishabh Pant reached extraordinary milestones in India's first Test against New Zealand at Basin Reserve, marking a historic day for the team. Gill, with a score of 98, became the first Indian to cross 3,000 WTC runs, while Pant followed suit as the first wicketkeeper to reach the milestone with his 55.
title: Gill, Pant script history, become first two Indians to achieve major WTC milestone

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Asaduddin Owaisi expressed that the emergence of the 'Samajik Parivartan Morcha' has notably unsettled both Yogi Adityanath and Akhilesh Yadav. With a strategy to become a formidable alternative for the upcoming 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections, Owaisi challenged the assertions of vote-splitting, highlighting the Samajwadi Party's mixed performance across different states.
title: 'Third contender has arrived': Owaisi says new UP alliance has unsettled Yogi, Akhilesh

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A landlord's attempts to reclaim a Manhattan apartment are hindered due to ongoing claims about rent stabilization. E. Terese Carpenter has resided in the unit for over 20 years, despite the existence of a commercial lease. The appeals court identified unresolved issues regarding the actual use of the apartment and the landlord's awareness of the situation.
title: NY woman can pursue rent stabilisation claim after 20 years on commercial lease

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Satya Nadella highlighted the significant impact of founders in the tech world, emphasizing their human characteristics rather than any mythical traits. He commended Jensen Huang for successfully transforming Nvidia into a robust organization capable of flourishing autonomously after the founder's exit. Nadella pointed out that true leadership is measured by an institution’s resilience. He expressed his admiration for Huang's lasting contributions to the technology sector.
title: Satya Nadella praises Jensen Huang but makes it clear that tech founders are not gods

author: VRITI JAIN
description: Dr. Pandit Rao Dharennavar has urged singer Diljit Dosanjh not to perform certain songs at his upcoming concert. The requested songs allegedly promote alcohol, drugs, and gun culture, which can negatively influence children. Despite a previous court order, similar songs were performed by Diljit at other concerts. Ahmedabad Police have made extensive security arrangements for the expected large crowd.
title: After Indore, Diljit Dosanjh warned of contempt plea over 4 songs in Ahmedabad

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Shubman Gill showcased his batting prowess with a near-century, scoring 98 runs during the opening Test at Basin Reserve against New Zealand. This performance places him among distinguished Indian cricketers with four Test dismissals in the 90s. With India's batting bolstered by Rishabh Pant's solid 55 not out, the team carries a substantial 118-run advantage into the crucial fourth day of play.
title: Shubman Gill joins Gambhir, Ganguly and Laxman in unwanted Indian Test record

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: In a recent statement, Donald Trump praised India's impressive 7% GDP growth while taking the Federal Reserve to task for its high interest rates. He opined that reducing these rates could spur US economic growth by 15 to 20 percent. Trump's advocacy for a stronger economy aligns with BJP leader Ashish Sood's approval of India's fiscal achievements, contrasting his earlier critiques of Indian trade policies from July 2025.
title: 'Turns a blind eye': BJP takes swipe at Rahul as Trump hails India's 7% GDP growth

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: O.M: Operation Mole, starring Mammootty, Dhanush, and Sai Pallavi, has made waves at the box office, earning Rs 17.70 crore on its opening day alone. Although audience reactions are mixed regarding the screenplay and performance, directed by Rajkumar Periasamy, this action crime thriller boasts a stellar ensemble cast. The film's continued success over the weekend is essential for sustaining its box office gains.
title: 'O.M' BO Day 2: Dhanush-Mammootty starrer maintains steady momentum

author: KARAN MANRAL
title: 'Will find way forward through dialogue': Shah on Siang dam protests in Arunachal

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
description: Seven people were killed in a gunfight between the Gilal and Kaloch tribes over a decades-old forest ownership dispute in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, PTI reported, quoting police. The clash took place in Battagram district on Thursday night, leaving four members of the Gilal tribe and three from the Kaloch tribe dead. Repeated efforts to resolve the dispute have failed.
title: 7 killed as tribal feud over forest ownership triggers gunfight in Pakistan

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: According to recent findings, Ahmedabad's airfare has escalated dramatically, climbing 74.8 percent for arrivals while outbound fares have only seen a 14.7 percent rise. This noteworthy trend has shown persistence over the last seven months, signaling that travelers should plan ahead and book their flights early to avoid escalating costs linked to routes ending in Ahmedabad.
title: India's steepest airfare surge is on flights to Ahmedabad

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy took a firm stand against U.S. President Donald Trump's portrayal of Vladimir Putin as a friend, branding him a foe and an assassin instead. He highlighted the dire circumstances of the war in Ukraine, asserting that such remarks diminish the urgency for Putin to alter his aggressive behavior.
title: Friend to Trump, 'killer' for Ukraine: Zelenskyy hits back as winds of winter looms

author: MANVI VYAS
description: Saiteja Eeramalla, a 25-year-old from Nalgonda, died in a tragic accident in New York. He had recently moved to the US for higher studies and found a job just before his death. On November 18, his car struck a deer, which led to a chain-reaction crash involving a cargo van. While Saiteja was critically injured, a passenger was airlifted to a hospital in serious condition.
title: Telangana man dies in New York multi-vehicle crash after deer hit

author: BAGISH JHA
description: A Gurgaon consumer commission has ordered online seller Saraf Furniture, which runs Insaraf.com, to refund Rs 28,814 with 9% interest to a buyer who found termite-like powder in a solid-wood bookcase. The seller promised a replacement that never arrived. The commission also awarded Rs 15,000 for harassment and Rs 10,000 costs, holding it guilty of deficiency in service.
title: Gurgaon man gets refund, Rs 25,000 compensation over defective bookcase

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Anvi Suvarna, a 10-year-old swimmer from Dombivli, completed a significant 36-km swim in open water. This achievement follows her earlier 17-km swim, marking notable progress in her endurance training. Her swim aimed to raise awareness about water conservation and marine pollution issues facing Maharashtra. Support from her parents has played a crucial role in her journey as a young athlete.
title: 10-year-old Anvi swims 36 km to Gateway of India in 8.5 hours

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: The remains of Rødhals Man were uncovered in a shell midden on Sejerø, shedding light on his dietary habits and way of life. Initial analysis reveals a seafood-based diet during his youth, evolving to include land-based food sources, likely due to nearby agricultural communities. His skeletal structure shows stress, suggesting a physically active life that adapted to these changes.
title: 6,000-year-old Danish skeleton reveals shift from seafood to farming

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Devdutt Padikkal's impressive 80 runs propelled India to a commanding position against New Zealand in the first Test. His crucial partnership with KL Rahul was instrumental in maintaining India's lead on Day 3. This performance enhances Padikkal's run tally and strengthens his place in the batting lineup. With six wickets remaining, Team India aims to further capitalise on their lead in the following sessions.
title: Another fifty, another statement! Devdutt Padikkal strengthens No.3 claim

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: The US Navy has officially decided against naming its upcoming Ford-class aircraft carrier after Donald Trump. Instead, it will be called the USS Doris Miller, a tribute to a Black American hero celebrated for his courageous actions during the Pearl Harbor attack. Despite lacking formal combat training, Miller bravely fought back and was awarded the Navy Cross on December 7, 1941. Meanwhile, discussions continue for potential vessels named after Trump.
title: US next aircraft carrier to honour Pearl Harbor hero, Navy rejects name change to Trump

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: Jacob Duffy faced difficulties during the first Test against India, conceding many runs and no-balls. New Zealand bowling coach Jacob Oram defended Duffy, emphasizing his consistent past performances over recent seasons. Oram suggests that Duffy's commitment to improvement remains strong despite this setback in Wellington. Meanwhile, India took control of the match, extending their lead significantly throughout day three of the Test.
title: 'He's not the only one': NZ coach backs Duffy after expensive outing against India

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Pennsylvania appeals court recently ruled to cancel a tax sale of a home in Garnet Valley. The tax sale occurred due to the county's failure to notify the correct property owner about unpaid taxes. Bonnie Wilson's home was sold despite her and her son Kevin both being deceased. The appeals court emphasized the need for tax bureaus to investigate further when notices are returned.
title: Pennsylvania court voids $109k home sale after tax notices sent to dead owner

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has responded to Amazon's warning about potential delivery cost increases. Amazon cautioned customers that a new city law could raise order prices by $5. The proposed Delivery Protection Act seeks to change operational methods of large delivery companies in the city. This legislation, supported by Mamdani, would directly employ workers involved in delivery services.
title: Mamdani hits back at Amazon over $5 delivery warning, calls it 'Bezos' greed'

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: Every time Shubman Gill raises his bat, he knows exactly where to look. Somewhere in the stands, his father, Lakhwinder, in his lucky white kurta-pyjama, is watching. In Wellington, the son delivered a masterclass but fell agonisingly short of a hundred.
title: Shubman Gill and the art of spotting his father in the stands

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
description: A US congressional commission has warned that China's growing military support for Pakistan could heighten the risk of a two-front conflict for India. In its report, it urged Washington to deepen defence cooperation with New Delhi, particularly in the Indian Ocean, including intelligence sharing and joint tracking of Chinese naval and submarine movements. It also flagged Beijing's expanding strategic presence in the region.
title: China-Pakistan ties raise two-front conflict risk for India: US report

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Trick Williams has officially secured his spot as the fifth member of Team USA for the upcoming Survivor Series: WarGames. His inclusion was negotiated by Cody Rhodes and CM Punk, amidst discussions involving other candidates like Hacksaw Jim Duggan. In his prior match against Damian Priest, Williams emerged victorious by disqualification due to a ring bell attack.
title: WWE Survivor Series: Team USA reveals its fifth and final member on SmackDown

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Pakistan's missile testing activities have intensified this year, with successful launches of cruise and ballistic missiles. The Army Rocket Force Command conducted multiple tests, including extended-range Fatah missiles to enhance capabilities. The Pakistan Navy participated with successful live-firing exercises involving air and ship-launched weapons. Recent development includes a focus on hypersonic ballistic missiles and new air-to-air systems. Overall, these advancements could challenge India's defense preparedness and escalation management abilities.
title: Pakistan's missile testing spree: New weapons, extended ranges and unverified claims

author: BAGISH JHA
description: A Gurgaon consumer commission ruled against a restaurant for compelling a family to purchase bottled water. The family had requested regular drinking water during their visit but was refused. After paying for bottled water, the family filed a complaint asserting unfair trade practices. The commission ordered the restaurant to refund the charged amount and pay compensation for mental harassment.
title: Rs 98 water bill costs Gurgaon restaurant Rs 31,098 in consumer court

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Dr. B Ramana Rao's unwavering commitment to health has seen him open his clinic every Sunday for over fifty years, recognizing the healthcare deficiencies in rural Karnataka. With his first free consultations commencing in 1973, he has touchingly assisted more than 33 lakh patients. Recently, he proudly achieved a Guinness World Record for conducting 2,777 consecutive Sunday medical camps, highlighting his vital role in promoting consistent healthcare in underserved communities.
title: Karnataka doctor enters Guinness record after 2,777 free Sunday camps

author: SMRIDHI DANG
description: More than 100,000 anonymous handwritten stories have been shared in The Strangers Project since its inception. Individuals recount personal experiences centered on themes such as love, loss, and hope. Brandon Doman founded the project in 2009 to create a space for these shared experiences. The Strangers Project is currently located at the World Trade Center Oculus in New York City.
title: More than 100,000 strangers have shared handwritten stories anonymously

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In a heroic effort to save the critically endangered Madagascar pochard, conservationists embarked on a challenging 44 km trek to rescue vulnerable eggs from their rain-soaked nests. From Lake Matsaborimena, they carefully retrieved 15 eggs and transported them to a breeding facility in Antsohihy. Their dedication bore fruit as six eggs successfully hatched, contributing to increasing the population of this rare duck species, now numbering around 180 individuals.
title: Madagascar conservationists carried 15 eggs of the world's rarest duck on foot to a breeding centre

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: FBI most-wanted cartel boss captured; gunfire at stadium sparks panic - video

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: The Pakistan Cricket Board has finalised central contracts for 38 players after a considerable delay. Key exclusions include Mohammad Rizwan, Shan Masood, and Imam-ul-Haq, who have faced recent challenges. Shadab Khan, the former captain, now receives a contract limited to T20, while Babar Azam remains in the Test and ODI categories.
title: Pakistan drop Rizwan, Shan Masood and Imam as PCB announces central contracts

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a tragic turn of events, Cheryl Lynn Rhines suffered a severe stroke while driving and was mistakenly arrested for intoxication. The responding trooper overlooked the critical nature of her medical emergency, causing significant delays in her treatment. This negligence resulted in lasting brain injuries and communication issues for Rhines.
title: NJ woman says trooper cuffed her during stroke; state appeals $11.25m verdict

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Fox Cricket has decided to rest Usman Khawaja and David Warner from commentary due to recent controversies. This decision follows new disclosures from Khawaja's autobiography and comments by Cameron Bancroft regarding the ball-tampering scandal. Bancroft's allegations have sparked debate about the awareness of the entire Australian team during the incident. Pat Cummins, facing scrutiny over these allegations, has denied any wrongdoing while retaining support from Cricket Australia.
title: Sandpapergate: Khawaja, Warner pulled from commentary duties amid fresh storm

author: AASTHA JHA
description: Congress MP Ranjeet Ranjan advised fellow MP Imran Masood to keep politics and sports separate. Masood had criticized the selection process after Mohammed Siraj was excluded from the Test squad. Siraj, India's top wicket-taker in the current World Test Championship cycle, was notable for his performance.
title: Congress vs Congress over Siraj: Party MP tells Imran Masood to 'not interfere'

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: PM Modi inaugurates Nitish Setu in Bihar, recreates poll-victory moment with 'gamcha' wave

author: VINDHYA PABOLU
description: On January 18, a Bengaluru man named MG Nagaraju experienced an injury caused by a broken grab handle on the Metro train. The incident occurred while he was holding the handle for support due to overcrowding. After initially being dismissed by officials, he filed a complaint when medical compensation was denied. The consumer commission ruled in favor of Nagaraju, holding BMRCL liable for deficiency in service.
title: Bengaluru man suffers nose injury after Metro grab handle snaps; BMRCL fined

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: Army jawan found dead near Jammu bus stand under suspicious circumstances

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: KL Rahul had a narrow escape during his innings after a missed DRS review by New Zealand. He was batting on five when Matt Henry's LBW appeal was turned down by the umpire. Glenn Phillips, who suggested there was an issue, did not push for the review. Rahul capitalized on this opportunity and scored 136 runs in the innings.
title: 'I'll buy him a few drinks': KL Rahul thanks Glenn Phillips for DRS blunder

author: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA
title: CBI Recovers Cash and jewellery from CGST Superintendent home

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In 2025, Florida implemented solar-powered robotic rabbit decoys designed to attract Burmese pythons for removal efforts. Researchers tracked 346 pythons from 2017 to 2024 to study their climbing behavior. The study found that juvenile pythons are more likely to climb trees compared to adults. A recent competition in 2026 resulted in 280 pythons being removed by participants. Since 2017, over 19,000 pythons have been captured in Florida through organized efforts.
title: As Florida uses robot rabbits to catch pythons; study reveals when snakes climb trees

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: 'Have more babies': Leavitt to Americans as Muslims projected to outnumber Christians

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: India made history in Wellington by having all top five batters score fifty-plus in an innings. KL Rahul highlighted the achievement with a century, while Yashasvi Jaiswal and Devdutt Padikkal offered valuable support. Captain Shubman Gill narrowly missed another Test hundred, and Rishabh Pant added a swift fifty. India ended Day 3 with a substantial 118-run lead and six wickets remaining.
title: India script history as top five batters cross 50 in same away Test innings

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
description: Pakistan minister Musadik Malik, in India for the SCO meeting, expressed a desire to visit the Taj Mahal and other historic landmarks. The Centre clarified that visiting ministers faced no travel restrictions. Malik also stressed the importance of cultural exchanges and dialogue in improving regional ties amid strained India-Pakistan relations following the 2025 Pahalgam terror attack.
title: Taj Mahal on wish list as Pak minister visits India; what Centre said on travel curbs

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: 'Look beyond image': Hindu seer's letter to Rahul, Priyanka over Shiva-Parvati post

author: SUHAS BIRHADE
description: A 17-year-old girl was allegedly gang-raped by two men in Kashigaon after a party invitation. Her 25-year-old friend Sheetal called her, introducing her to three men before leaving them together. The accused forced the girl to consume alcohol and then took turns assaulting her throughout the night. It was discovered she was missing when her mother made inquiries about her whereabouts.
title: Girl gangraped at party in Mumbai, FIR on woman, 3 others

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Batting on 98, Gill was looking to reach his hundred before the close of play when Duffy got a delivery to move back in and breach his defence.
title: Gill misses century by two runs: Duffy ends Shubman's innings in last over of day 3

author: PARTHA BEHERA
description: The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in Raipur ruled that National Insurance Company must pay an insured couple. The commission found the insurer's claim rejection unjustified regarding a super top-up policy. Madhukant Agrawal and his wife incurred significant medical expenses after her heart surgery. They received partial reimbursement under a basic mediclaim policy, and claimed additional funds under the super top-up.
title: Raipur couple gets Rs 5.46 lakh after National Insurance claim dispute

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: ‘Cradle for national movements’: PM hails Bengal's legacy at IIT Kharagpur event

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Sarfaraz Khan faced serious allegations regarding a dressing room leak during India's Australia tour. He expressed how these rumors affected his family and emotional state. Coach Gautam Gambhir supported him by advising him to focus on his game instead. Sarfaraz denied the allegations, emphasising his selection for upcoming matches to demonstrate his commitment. He continues to perform well in domestic cricket, showcasing his resilience and talent.
title: 'My wife was crying': Sarfaraz Khan on dressing room leak row

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Deirdre Keane, an inspiring nurse practitioner from New York, achieved a remarkable feat in 2026 by completing all seven World Marathon Majors while pregnant. Approaching her training thoughtfully after learning about her pregnancy, she ran the New York City Marathon at 34 weeks, pushing boundaries she once thought were fixed.
title: NY nurse, 38, completes all 7 marathon majors while pregnant, last at 34 weeks

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Captain Shubman Gill came close to scoring a century but was dismissed for 98 in the final over of the day. Jacob Duffy bowled him just two runs short of the landmark. Rishabh Pant remained unbeaten on 55, while nightwatchman Anshul Kamboj was yet to open his account at stumps.
title: IND vs NZ: KL Rahul hits century, Gill misses ton by two runs as India dominate

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: On November 21, 1963, India launched its first sounding rocket from Thumba, establishing its space program. The rocket, Nike-Apache, carried instruments for atmospheric studies and marked a major milestone. Established by Dr. Vikram Sarabhai, the Indian National Committee for Space Research organized early research and development. Following this, the Indian Space Research Organisation was formed in 1969 and developed indigenous rockets.
title: Before Chandrayaan, Mangalyaan, there was Nike-Apache: India's 1st sounding rocket launch

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Swasti Vitthal Patil achieved remarkable success by winning a bronze medal at the European Girls’ Olympiad in Informatics in 2025. The next year, she proudly brought home a gold medal, setting a historic precedent for India. Her unique approach to learning and her achievements emphasize the growing involvement of girls in the field of competitive programming, motivating aspiring students to defy conventional educational norms in mathematics and computer science.
title: Pune student wins India's first gold at European girls' informatics Olympiad

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, claims to have solved the Riemann Hypothesis, an unsolved mathematical problem. His proof, developed with the assistance of Anthropic's AI model Claude, consists of over 250,000 pages. While mathematicians are currently reviewing his proof, it has not yet been formally accepted by the community for verification. The announcement surfaced just days after Anthropic's public market debut, drawing considerable attention.
title: Anthropic mathematician says AI cracked math’s famous problem; Sundar Pichai reacts

author: MATEEN HAFEEZ
description: An incident of harassment and assault occurred involving a couple in Ghatkopar, Mumbai. Eight juveniles confronted the couple at a garden, leading to violent actions. The situation escalated from a verbal exchange to physical aggression, with one juvenile using a stick. A case has been filed against the juveniles under several sections of the law.
title: Punch, sticks and more: Young couple assaulted in Mumbai park; 8 minors booked

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: 'Trampling Sikh sentiments': Oppn questions naming of Bihar bridge as Nitish Setu

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: 'Screamed, threatened employees': Nvidia ex-HR's allegations against Jensen Huang resurface

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: David and Sara LeBlanc have taken legal action against Ogunquit, Maine, after being penalized for setting up rooster sculptures outside their home. These sculptures symbolize support for their daughter Pyper, who is autistic and adores roosters. The town has classified the sculptures as commercial advertising for their restaurant, Omelette Factory, and although the couple has removed them, local residents have rallied to display the sculptures in unity.
title: Maine couple fined $1,700 for giant roosters meant to comfort daughter; they sue

author: VINDHYA PABOLU
description: After a failed pregnancy, Amrutha encountered serious medical challenges that resulted in three D&C procedures. Initially treated by Dr. Shailaja at Rainbow Children’s Hospital, she suffered from poor care that caused dangerous complications, necessitating additional treatment in Madurai. The Bangalore I Additional District Consumer Commission ruled the doctor negligent and awarded Amrutha compensation for her traumatic experiences.
title: Bengaluru woman gets Rs 2 lakh over doctor negligence in twin pregnancy case

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Dhoni will no longer take the field for CSK but will remain associated with the five-time champions as their team mentor from IPL 2027. Zaheer said the team would miss having Dhoni as a player but was looking forward to working with him in his new role.
title: 'Making my job easier': Zaheer Khan opens up on Dhoni's 'unexpected' retirement

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Susan Lewis's noble desire to donate her body to science was thwarted by a miscommunication. After her passing, her husband, Warren Lewis, tirelessly advocated for revisions to the university's body donation policy. This advocacy birthed a collaboration with Macquarie University, enabling weekend donations and ensuring that future donors' wishes are honored, despite bureaucratic hurdles. Susan's journey underscores the complexities surrounding body donations in Australia.
title: Wife dies on weekend, body donation refused; husband's campaign changes rules

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: 'Grand Theft India': AAP mocks PM, HM Shah in GTA 6 spoof featuring Raghav Chadha

author: PRIYANKA MUKHERJEE
description: Sanjay Raut is advocating for the renaming of Nagpur to Deekshabhoomi as a tribute to Dr B R Ambedkar. The demand comes after Maharashtra government's plan to change Dadar Metro station to Chaityabhoomi.
title: 'Rename Nagpur as Deekshabhoomi': Raut's demand amid Dadar Metro renaming row

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: 'Sonia was real owner of Maruti': BJP's Nishikant Dubey makes big claim

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: KL Rahul achieved a significant milestone by scoring his 13th Test century against New Zealand in Wellington. This century places him among India's most successful Test openers in history. He has now scored a total of twelve centuries as an opener, surpassing Gautam Gambhir and Rohit Sharma. Additionally, he has completed the rare feat of scoring centuries in all four SENA countries.
title: 12 vs 9: KL Rahul way ahead of Gautam Gambhir and Rohit Sharma

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: The CA Board resolved to express its unanimous support for Pat Cummins as captain
title: 'To protect integrity': CA drops big statement on Cummins captaincy

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: ‘We will not allow that’: Trump warns Iran over ‘rumour’ of Tehran's dirty bomb plot

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In a landmark ruling, Louisiana farmer Benjamin Lee Bird emerged victorious in a lengthy 13-year battle over a disputed land strip. The court upheld his ownership, leading to a damages award against his neighbours for their actions, which included tree removal and altering drainage systems on Bird's land. The appeals court confirmed his rights, adjusting the compensation to $59,966.
title: Louisiana farmer wins $59,967 after neighbours clear trees from 18ft land strip

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Project Wave, spearheaded by Shiv Mandlik, emerged from his recognition of the dangers faced by construction workers and their families. This initiative is dedicated to raising safety awareness and supplying modern protective gear, having already reached more than 105,000 workers through training, equipment provision, and welfare support in various cities. Beyond safety, it tackles vital concerns like housing and hygiene, demonstrating Mandlik's unwavering commitment to the well-being of construction laborers.
title: Ahmedabad student turns fatal fall into safety mission for 1 lakh workers

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: Devdutt Padikkal and KL Rahul share more than a batting partnership. A coffee obsession that began during India's 2024-25 Australia tour has taken over the dressing room, with players carrying their own brewing equipment on tours. At Wellington, the duo's 165-run stand showcased their understanding, patience composure, and blending cricketing chemistry with a shared love for the perfect brew.
title: A perfect brew, a perfect blend: Rahul and Padikkal's coffee camaraderie

author: TNN
description: A businessman has come forward with disturbing claims of extortion threats, where he was asked for Rs 60 lakh, accompanied by a half-cut Rs 10 note as a chilling message. Police investigations led them to Ashu Maurya after analyzing delivered envelopes and reviewing CCTV footage. Maurya ultimately confessed to the crime, driven by financial struggles, and revealed prior acquaintance with the victim's family.
title: Man poses as Lawrence Bishnoi's kin to extort Delhi businessman

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: FBI hacked again: Cyberattack targets national crime database used by US police

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A negligence lawsuit has emerged following a tragic e-bike accident involving a 14-year-old boy during a birthday sleepover hosted by Tessa and Matthew Cohen. The allegations claim that the Cohens provided electric bikes without adequate supervision or safety protocols. As a result, the boy sustained life-altering injuries, requiring significant medical attention. The lawsuit demands $8.7 million in damages to address his painful recovery and its long-term consequences.
title: Oregon mother sues couple for $8.7m after son loses eye on e-bike at sleepover

author: HAIMANTI MUKHERJEE
title: Pregnancy in the age of AI: Too much information is making mothers-to-be very anxious

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: Gen Z protests sweep Europe: Why thousands are taking to streets in 25 countries

author: AYUSH PANDEY
